prespecification_note: Written and checksum-pinned after reading only the study-design text of the NEOFORDEX assessment report (EMA/CHMP/6613/2016, section 2.4.2) and before reading its results tables (Tables 11-14) or computing any comparison. Not blinded to Spoorenberg et al. 2014 (read in full on 21 October 2026; it is used here as descriptive context only, for the reason stated below) or to the label-based curve from 3.1f (CL/F 15.7 L/h, V/F 90.6 L, ka 3.04/h; single 20 mg dose: Cmax 186 ng/mL, AUC0-inf 1274 ng.h/mL).
not_this: Not validation; no acceptance limits for clinical use are introduced.
Not a comparison of individual concentrations; only published summaries are used.
Not a dosing or exposure prediction for any patient.
question: Does the label-based dexamethasone curve (HEMADY, 3.1f) agree with exposure measured in patients with multiple myeloma and in healthy volunteers in studies reported by the European Medicines Agency for a different dexamethasone product?

source.document: Neofordex (dexamethasone) EPAR public assessment report, EMA/CHMP/6613/2016
source.independence: Different product and applicant (Laboratoires CTRS; the myeloma study is Celgene's CC-5013-MM-017). Whether any of the same data underlie the HEMADY label is not known.

label_curve.parameters: Set A_stated_label, ka from Tmax 1 h, unchanged. Doses other than 20 mg are scaled linearly, as the label states dose proportionality from 0.5 to 40 mg.
label_curve.emulation: Model AUC over the same interval as the observed AUC (0-inf by closed form; 0-t by numerical integration to t); Cmax as the curve maximum.

primary_MM017_day2.population: 6 Japanese patients with previously treated multiple myeloma
primary_MM017_day2.dose: dexamethasone 40 mg orally, single dose on day 2 without lenalidomide that day, after an overnight fast
primary_MM017_day2.why_primary: The only dexamethasone exposure data in the report from patients with multiple myeloma, the label's indication.

secondary_CPA402_11.population: healthy volunteers, fasted, n = 24 per treatment in a crossover
secondary_CPA402_11.dose: 20 mg single oral dose: half a Neofordex 40 mg tablet (test) and 44 x Dectancyl 0.5 mg tablets (reference)

datasets.descriptive_MM017_day12: Day 12 of the same cohort (repeated 40 mg dosing with lenalidomide): reported against the single-dose curve without classification, because the label curve is single-dose and lenalidomide is present.
datasets.descriptive_Spoorenberg_2014: Spoorenberg et al., Br J Clin Pharmacol 2014;78:78-83 (6 mg oral, 15 patients hospitalized with community-acquired pneumonia; file sha256 e549123b7b7af6d2f9f10951a542a94fb90c09d5052731de29cce5a9bcc3b2ad). Shown as context only: acute illness and age are expected to lower CYP3A4 activity, so it does not represent the label's population or myeloma patients, and its values were read before this plan.

endpoints.primary: AUC (0-inf if reported, otherwise the reported interval) in MM-017 day 2.
secondary: AUC0-inf and AUC0-36 in CPA-402-11, each arm.
descriptive: Tmax and half-life in every dataset

comparison.interval_rule: 95% confidence interval of the observed central value, built from what the report gives: arithmetic mean and SD -> mean +/- t(0.975, n-1) SD/sqrt(n); geometric mean and CV% -> exp(ln GM +/- t(0.975, n-1) s/sqrt(n)) with s = sqrt(ln(1 + CV^2)); arithmetic mean and CV% -> SD = CV x mean, then the arithmetic rule. If only medians or ranges are given, the endpoint is descriptive.
comparison.classification: consistent (model inside the interval), model_over_predicts (above), model_under_predicts (below).
comparison.ratio: model / observed central value reported for every endpoint.

decision_rule.summary: The label-based dexamethasone curve is recorded as consistent with outside data if the primary endpoint is consistent and the AUC0-inf of both CPA-402-11 arms is consistent. Cmax results are reported with their classification but do not decide, because 3.1f already recorded the peak as the weak point.
decision_rule.consequence: If consistent, a later step may show dexamethasone at Label-based exposure, citing this check and the population caveats (6 Japanese patients; healthy volunteers). If not, the curve stays hidden and the disagreement is recorded.
decision_rule.never: The label curve is not changed after seeing the results; no dataset is dropped or added after this plan.

known_differences: MM-017: n = 6, Japanese patients, 40 mg given as 4 mg tablets; the label curve is scaled from 20 mg.
CPA-402-11: healthy volunteers, other products; a typical-value curve is compared with summary statistics.
Assays and NCA software differ between the label's studies and these studies.
